# Glossary review: Indonesian (`id`)

*Written by `python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`; `check` compares it with a fresh run. Do not edit it.*

Glossary version `1.0.0-draft`. These are DRAFTS until you approve them.

## What to check

1. Is the canonical form the word a trader of this language really uses for the term?
2. Are the other accepted spellings words a trader would also type (a short form, a plural, a verb form)? A question that contains any of them is recognised as containing the term.
3. Does any spelling also mean something else in this language? It would mark an unrelated question.
4. Do the texts below read naturally, say what the English says, and keep each `{name}` placeholder?

## Fixed replies, instant prompts and reason texts

| Key | English | Indonesian |
| --- | --- | --- |
| intake.refusal.not_signed_in | Please sign in to ask the AI analyst. | Silakan masuk untuk bertanya kepada analis AI. |
| intake.refusal.tier_required | The AI analyst is part of the Pro plan. | Analis AI adalah bagian dari paket Pro. |
| intake.refusal.thread_invalid | This conversation is not available. Start a new one about gold (XAUUSD). | Percakapan ini tidak tersedia. Mulai percakapan baru tentang emas (XAUUSD). |
| intake.refusal.profile_not_set | Confirm your trading profile first. | Konfirmasikan profil trading Anda terlebih dahulu. |
| intake.refusal.quota_insufficient | Your AI analyst allowance is used up for now. Please try again later. | Kuota analis AI Anda sedang habis. Silakan coba lagi nanti. |
| intake.refusal.feature_unavailable | The AI analyst is not available yet. | Analis AI belum tersedia. |
| intake.refusal.question_empty | Type a question about gold (XAUUSD) first. | Ketik dulu pertanyaan tentang emas (XAUUSD). |
| intake.refusal.question_too_long | Your question is too long. Please keep it to {limit} characters or fewer. | Pertanyaan Anda terlalu panjang. Mohon batasi maksimal {limit} karakter. |
| intake.refusal.understanding_failed | That question could not be read just now. Please try again. | Pertanyaan itu tidak dapat dibaca saat ini. Silakan coba lagi. |
| intake.refusal.out_of_scope | This analyst covers gold (XAUUSD) on the M5 and M15 charts only. Ask about those. | Analis ini hanya mencakup emas (XAUUSD) pada grafik M5 dan M15. Silakan bertanya tentang itu. |
| intake.instant.m5 | Explain the current M5 chart | Jelaskan grafik M5 saat ini |
| intake.instant.m15 | Explain the current M15 chart | Jelaskan grafik M15 saat ini |
| intake.reason.data_stale | The market data is out of date, so this sensor has no usable reading. | Data pasar sudah usang, sehingga sensor ini tidak memiliki pembacaan yang dapat dipakai. |
| intake.reason.retuning | The chart indicator is being re-tuned, so this reading is less reliable for now. | Indikator grafik sedang disetel ulang, sehingga pembacaan ini sementara kurang andal. |
| intake.reason.no_setting | No indicator setting is available for this timeframe, so this sensor cannot read it. | Tidak ada pengaturan indikator untuk kerangka waktu ini, sehingga sensor ini tidak dapat membacanya. |
| intake.reason.detection_mismatch | The indicator found in the data does not match its setting, so treat this reading with caution. | Indikator yang ditemukan di data tidak cocok dengan pengaturannya, jadi perlakukan pembacaan ini dengan waspada. |
| intake.reason.no_stats_at_slot | The statistics for this moment are not available yet, so this reading is out of date. | Statistik untuk saat ini belum tersedia, sehingga pembacaan ini sudah usang. |
| intake.reason.containment_low | The price is not staying inside the channel well enough for a reliable reading. | Harga tidak cukup bertahan di dalam kanal untuk pembacaan yang andal. |
| intake.reason.insufficient_bars | There are not enough closed bars yet for a reliable reading. | Belum ada cukup candle tertutup untuk pembacaan yang andal. |
| intake.reason.discontinuity | The bars have gaps or are out of order, so this reading cannot be trusted. | Candle memiliki celah atau urutannya salah, sehingga pembacaan ini tidak dapat dipercaya. |
| intake.reason.sanity_failed | The channel values are impossible, so this reading cannot be trusted. | Nilai kanal tidak mungkin terjadi, sehingga pembacaan ini tidak dapat dipercaya. |
| intake.reason.upstream_cautionary | {sensor} is cautionary, so this reading is cautionary too. | {sensor} berstatus waspada, sehingga pembacaan ini juga perlu diwaspadai. |
| intake.reason.upstream_unavailable | {sensor} has no valid reading, so this one is unavailable. | {sensor} tidak memiliki pembacaan yang valid, sehingga pembacaan ini tidak tersedia. |
| intake.reason.upstream_stale | {sensor} is out of date, so this one is too. | {sensor} sudah usang, sehingga pembacaan ini juga usang. |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m5 | The M5 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | Kanal M5 kurang cocok dengan harga, sehingga pembacaan yang memakainya perlu diwaspadai. |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m15 | The M15 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | Kanal M15 kurang cocok dengan harga, sehingga pembacaan yang memakainya perlu diwaspadai. |
| intake.reason.evaluator_error | This sensor hit an unexpected error and has no reading right now. | Sensor ini mengalami kesalahan tak terduga dan saat ini tidak memiliki pembacaan. |
| intake.reason.modifier_caution | Another sensor adds caution to this reading: {state}. | Sensor lain menambahkan kewaspadaan pada pembacaan ini: {state}. |

## Sign-off

Read the tables above, then edit `approval.json` in this folder: set `status` to `APPROVED`, `approved_by` to your name and `approved_on` to the date (YYYY-MM-DD). It holds the SHA-256 of the content you read, so a later change to it puts this area back to PENDING (`python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`). Then run `record` once more so the forms of Indonesian are marked `approved` in the glossary.
